description:
TED is a private institution in Turkey. It was founded in 2012 and is part of the TED (Turkish Education Association) Group, a well-known educational institution in Turkey with roots dating back to 1928. The university's campus is in Ankara, Turkey's capital city. It has sophisticated facilities that facilitate students' academic and extracurricular interests, such as classrooms, laboratories, libraries, and recreational places. The goal of TED University was to provide a high-quality education that blends academic achievement with an emphasis on research and innovation. Thus, faculty and students are encouraged to participate in cross-disciplinary research projects. The university also encourages entrepreneurship and industrial collaboration. According to the "Turkish University Satisfaction Survey" 2023, TEDU is among the top five universities in student satisfaction. TED University aspires to develop international connections and partnerships. This includes student exchange programs, collaborative research projects, and partnerships with institutions worldwide.

TED University provides undergraduate and graduate degrees in a variety of disciplines, including engineering, natural sciences, social sciences, humanities, and arts. The institution strives to give its students a well-rounded education. Here are the programs that TEDU offers:

To support its diverse student community, TED University provides a variety of housing and living situations. Two dorms are operated by TED University, where students may stay if they can afford it. On-campus housing in the form of dorms or residence halls is frequently available for those looking for convenience and a supportive environment. All students at TED University have access to modern housing options. Students can meet their needs in the Student Dorm for girls, which has 392 beds, and the Student Dorm for boys, which has 93 beds. International students can apply to the International Programs Office (IPO) for a place in the dorms. The IPO also assists in helping people find private housing (house-sharing). These facilities provide students with vital amenities such as furnished rooms, internet access, and public areas, resulting in a comfortable living environment. Additionally, to help new students with their housing arrangements when they arrive, the institution provides ten days of free housing at the beginning of their term. Alternatively, some students may choose to live off-campus in private flats or shared accommodation, taking advantage of the university's many housing alternatives in Ankara. If necessary, TED University will assist in locating acceptable off-campus housing. Students can benefit from various campus facilities, transportation alternatives, and a commitment to safety and security, whether on or off campus, offering a fulfilling and secure living experience. In the event of a health problem, students can visit the campus Health Care Center and obtain free examination and first-aid services. In emergencies, immediate treatment is offered at the health care center, and transfer to the hospital is provided if necessary. Therefore, in your new journey, the university will be helpful.
